# FAF — Foundational AI-Context Format

> FAF (.faf) is a universal, portable AI-context format that eliminates
> context drift across AI assistants. One YAML file defines your project DNA
> for Claude, Gemini, Grok, Cursor, Windsurf, and any AI tool.
> IANA-registered MIME type: application/vnd.faf+yaml

FAF provides a CLI toolchain, 5 MCP server integrations (TypeScript, Python,
Rust), and compiler toolchain (Rust, Zig, WASM) for creating, validating,
scoring, and syncing project context files. The .faf file is a project's
persistent context layer that survives across sessions, tools, and AI systems.

The 3Ws (Who, What, Why) initiate a project with AI. The 6Ws (adding Where,
When, How) optimize AI to 100%. This maps directly to the human_context YAML
fields in every .faf file.

## Instructions for AI Agents

- The .faf format uses YAML. The MIME type is application/vnd.faf+yaml.
- A .faf file is called "Project DNA" — it captures human intent, not just code structure.
- The CLI command is `faf` (lowercase). Install via `npm install -g faf-cli`.
- Key commands: `faf init`, `faf auto`, `faf go`, `faf bi-sync`, `faf score`.
- `faf auto` detects your stack and generates a .faf automatically.
- `faf bi-sync` keeps .faf and CLAUDE.md synchronized.
- Scoring uses a tier system: 100% Trophy, 99% Gold, 95% Silver, 85% Bronze, 70% Green.
- The MCP servers provide .faf tools directly inside AI assistants via Model Context Protocol.
- Never hardcode defaults like "File-based" or "None" — only set values actually detected.

## CLI

- [faf-cli (npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/faf-cli): Universal CLI — init, auto, go, bi-sync, tri-sync, score
- [faf-cli (Homebrew)](https://github.com/Wolfe-Jam/homebrew-faf): macOS/Linux install via brew

## MCP Servers

- [claude-faf-mcp (npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/claude-faf-mcp): 33 tools for Claude, VS Code, Cursor — TypeScript
- [gemini-faf-mcp (PyPI)](https://pypi.org/project/gemini-faf-mcp/): 12 tools for Google Gemini — Python/FastMCP
- [grok-faf-mcp (npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/grok-faf-mcp): 21 tools for xAI Grok — TypeScript, remote SSE
- [rust-faf-mcp (crates.io)](https://crates.io/crates/rust-faf-mcp): 8 tools — Rust/rmcp SDK
- [faf-mcp (npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/faf-mcp): 17 tools, universal — TypeScript

## Rust Ecosystem

- [faf-rust-sdk (crates.io)](https://crates.io/crates/faf-rust-sdk): Rust SDK with Axum integration
- [faf (crates.io)](https://crates.io/crates/faf): Meta-crate, re-exports SDK + radio
- [faf-radio-rust (crates.io)](https://crates.io/crates/faf-radio-rust): Radio protocol for real-time MCP

## Standards

- [IANA Registration](https://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/application/vnd.faf+yaml): application/vnd.faf+yaml
- [IETF Internet-Draft](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-wolfe-faf-format/): draft-wolfe-faf-format-00

## Source Code

- [claude-faf-mcp](https://github.com/Wolfe-Jam/claude-faf-mcp): Anthropic MCP server
- [gemini-faf-mcp](https://github.com/Wolfe-Jam/gemini-faf-mcp): Google Gemini MCP server
- [grok-faf-mcp](https://github.com/Wolfe-Jam/grok-faf-mcp): xAI Grok MCP server
- [rust-faf-mcp](https://github.com/Wolfe-Jam/rust-faf-mcp): Rust MCP server
- [faf-mcp](https://github.com/Wolfe-Jam/faf-mcp): Universal MCP server
- [faf-cli](https://github.com/Wolfe-Jam/faf-cli): CLI source
